summary: NHTSA concluded that manufacturers had not demonstrated a fuel economy penalty from the revised MY 1979 emission standard, with further discussion deferred to the preamble of the final rule.
text: Analysis. The agency has determined that the manufacturers have not made a case for a fuel economy penalty resulting from the revised emission standard for MY 1979. This is discussed further in the preamble to the final rule.
